name: Tumerok Fort (3.1N, 60.5W)
title: 3.1N, 60.5W - Tumerok Fort
summary: A Tumerok fort on top of a flat barren-rock mesa (z 250) in the Dires near Fort Tethana (Points of Interest Map no. 27). The kit shows a square of flat-roofed halls with stake palisades, three 31 m spire towers (0x01001161) at its corners and a lone fourth tower (0x01001117) 50 m to the west. The mesa flanks fall to 110-180 m on the west, north and east.

landmarks.name: South-east spire tower
landmarks.note: 0x01001161. The other spire towers stand at (9924,25236) and (9972,25236).

site.name: Tumerok Fort (3.1N, 60.5W)
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the mesa at (9995,25160), ground 250, 26 m from the nearest tower.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (danbys-outpost -> fort-tethana).

shots.standingOrder: Climb in a slow counter-clockwise corkscrew south of the mesa-top fort from 10 m to 34 m above the plateau, 75 to 90 m out, keeping the three spire towers centred; never pass west of the lone tower.
shots.notes: The fort stands on a flat mesa top (z 250) with three 31 m spire towers and a lone fourth tower to the west. The drone corkscrews counter-clockwise from south-south-west to south, climbing from 10 m to 34 m above the plateau and widening from 75 m to 90 m. The halls, stake palisades and towers turn against the falling flanks of the mesa, and the south-west sun lights the faces turned to the lens. The arc never crosses the line to the lone west tower.
